data_point: Live website with a real product or service
run_when: The site loaded but looked thin (little text or few pages).

prompt.task: Decide whether this website belongs to an operating business with a real product or service someone can buy or use.
prompt.definition: A live site that describes a specific product or service customers can buy, sign up for or book.
yes_when: The site describes a specific product or service with features, plans or a way to sign up, buy or book
no_when: The page is a parked domain or says the domain is for sale
Only a 'coming soon' or 'under construction' page
unknown_when: The text is too short or generic to tell what the company offers
watch_out_for: A single-page site can still be a real business if it clearly describes what it sells
A waitlist page for an unreleased product is not a live product yet

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.why: Needs the company's own site; search results can't prove the site is live.

examples.input_excerpt: Linear is a purpose-built tool for planning and building products. Start building. Pricing: Free, Basic $10 per user

output.evidence_quote: Linear is a purpose-built tool for planning and building products
output.reason: The site describes a product with paid plans.
